rationale: Record a disk-hygiene change to the browser launchers: tools/import-design/browser_capture/browser_process.mjs adds MacAppCodeSignClone to its existing --disable-features list, and tools/import-validation/chrome_gradient_oracle.py and tools/coordination/capture-webview-baseline.sh pass --disable-features=MacAppCodeSignClone, so branded macOS Chrome stops copying its app bundle into the per-user temp dir on every launch and leaving it behind when torn down by signal. The import-design skill gains the matching gotcha. No capture semantics, DesignIR, rendering, thresholds or packaging change; the capture integration suite passes unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
